issue.title: 一言コメントの「AIに相談する」から既存チャットを開く

summary: Open the existing AI advisor drawer from the Dashboard comment CTA with the current scoped filters and comment context, without creating a duplicate chat surface.
decisions: Reuse the existing right-side AI drawer and active thread behavior.
Pass only redacted, workspace-scoped filter/comment context.
Opening the drawer does not auto-send a message or consume AI usage.

out: Raw internal/customer IDs in visible prompt

requirementRefs: DESIGN.md#2-アプリケーション構成

risks.description: Each click may create duplicate conversations.
risks.mitigation: Reuse the current scoped thread until the user explicitly starts a new one.

risks.description: Unscoped IDs or hidden data could be injected into the chat.
risks.mitigation: Build a redacted display/context DTO after workspace scope validation.

risks.description: Opening the drawer may auto-send and consume quota.
risks.mitigation: Require an explicit user send and test zero usage on open.

acceptanceCriteria: CTA opens the existing right drawer and moves keyboard focus into it.
The current workspace/account/date/comment context is shown in redacted human-readable form.
No message is sent and no AI quota is consumed until explicit submit.
Current thread is reused; explicit new-thread behavior remains available.
Minimum-plan lock and exhausted-quota states remain visible and usable for history/settings.
Mobile drawer can be opened, closed, and returned from without losing Dashboard state.

rollback.strategy: Disable the contextual CTA and leave the existing global drawer launcher intact.
rollback.verification: Existing chat history/send journeys pass and Dashboard state is unchanged.
